live.description: default live preview (tools/dev/live_world.py lease; driven by live actions)

screenwalk.description: ClientAutotest screen walk (non-live): creates creative world seed 1234, opens race/skills/hub/inventory/magic/journal/map, wildlife, mysticism, spellmaking, staff enchanter; captures to build/autotest-screenshots then quits

visualtest.description: VisualAutotest default steps: new world seed 20261010 from the title screen, night sky, weathers, HUD target/banners/sneak eye, saving/pause/confirm/death/inventory/race screens; captures to build/visualtest-screenshots then quits (any non-empty value other than "clouds")

npcshowcase.description: NpcShowcase: every race in outfits lined up; needs saves/npcws or a quickPlay singleplayer world; captures to build/npc-showcase then quits

raceshowcase.description: RaceShowcase: flat creative world at Steam Deck size; character creator and race line-ups into build/race-showcase then quits

mounts.description: MountsAutotest mount line-ups at lineupX/lineupZ in an autotest world

lab.description: offline tools (native/build/Release/atlas_render.exe, pack_lab.exe); no game client
